name: Kinetic launch
description: Headline lines rise out of masks, the highlight sweeps a gradient, the CTA shines — beside your product in a browser.

name: Kinetic headline
description: A big centered kinetic headline with a gradient highlight and a shining button — a reel or story opener.

name: Bento features
description: Six feature cards cascade into a bento grid, each with its own micro-interaction: toggles, a goal ring, avatars, bars, a check, a counter.

name: Pricing toggle
description: Plans rise in, the popular one lifts, the billing switch flips to yearly and every price counts down.

name: Stats that count
description: Three big numbers count up under drawing arcs, with an animated heading.

name: Review wall
description: A tilted wall of five-star reviews drifts in three columns behind a big social-proof headline.

name: Trusted by
description: Two rows of customer wordmarks glide in opposite directions under a “trusted by” line.

name: Launch countdown
description: Big digits tick down from 5 as a ring drains, then a burst and “Now live”. For drops and launches.

name: App showcase
description: Your app screenshot rises in a phone while feature badges pop in and float around it.

name: Spotlight tour
description: A spotlight walks across your product recording — the rest dims, and a numbered caption explains each area.

name: Feature hotspots
description: Pulsing hotspots with callout labels appear one by one over your product recording.

name: AI assistant demo
description: An assistant app in action: the question types itself, a thinking shimmer, then the answer streams in with a chart.

name: Command palette
description: Over your product, a command palette opens, a search types, the selection moves, Enter — and a toast confirms.

name: Live dashboard
description: An analytics dashboard builds itself: KPIs count up, the line draws, bars grow and a goal ring fills.

name: Automation run
description: Workflow nodes appear and connect, then a pulse runs the flow and every step checks off.

name: Code to deploy
description: An editor types your snippet, a terminal builds and deploys it, and the live URL pops up. For developer tools.

name: App walkthrough (taps)
description: Your app recording in a phone, with tap ripples and feature badges popping in beside it.

name: Follow card
description: A photo-app style follow card slides up over your video; the Follow button presses and turns into Following.

name: Follow prompt
description: Short-video style: avatar pops in, the plus flips to a check, followers tick up and Follow becomes Following.

name: Post card
description: A microblog-style post pops up over your video, then the heart fills and the like count ticks up.

name: Post card (dark)
description: The dark post card beside your landscape video — reactions, quotes and announcements.

name: Forum post
description: A community-forum style post: the upvote fills and the score climbs. Great for story-time and AMA clips.

name: Now playing
description: A music-player card with your cover art; levels bounce and the progress bar and clock run with the clip.

name: Message thread
description: A text conversation plays out: bubbles arrive one by one, with a typing indicator before each reply.

name: Desktop notification
description: A desktop-style notification banner slides in at the top right of your video and back out.

name: Subscribe lower third
description: Video-channel style: your channel slides in, a cursor clicks Subscribe and the bell rings.

name: Comment stack
description: Three viewer comments pop in one after another and each gets a like.

name: Editorial flash
description: Color bars sweep across your video and a condensed headline slams in — for news, drops and hot takes.

name: Live stream
description: A pulsing LIVE badge, a viewer count that climbs and chat messages scrolling in over your video.

name: Product launch
description: A bold launch headline beside your product in a browser window, over a glowing mesh.

name: Feature spotlight
description: One feature explained in a card, with the product in action next to it.

name: Feature trio
description: Three features as icon cards under a section title, on a dark grid.

name: How it works
description: Three numbered steps joined by a line, for onboarding and explainers.

name: Integrations
description: Your product at the center of the tools it connects to.

name: Pricing tiers
description: Three plans side by side with the recommended one raised.

name: Plan spotlight
description: One plan, its price and what's included, for Reels and Stories.

name: Promo code
description: A big discount and a code to copy, square for feeds.

name: KPI highlights
description: Three headline numbers on cards, for updates and investor recaps.

name: Growth chart
description: A headline beside a gradient bar chart of your growth.

name: Customer story
description: A five-star quote with the customer's headshot, on a light canvas.

name: Trusted by
description: A wall of customer wordmarks under a social-proof headline.

name: Us vs them
description: A feature checklist comparing your product with the alternatives.

name: Case study
description: A customer's logo, their big result and a one-line quote — square.

name: Webinar promo
description: Date, title and details of a live session, with the host below.

name: Event announcement
description: A square event card with a register button, for LinkedIn and X.

name: Launch countdown
description: A teaser with a big countdown and an early-access button — vertical.

name: App promo
description: Your app on a phone with a headline and download button — vertical.

name: What's new
description: A release card with what's new, improved and fixed.

name: Sales notifications
description: App notifications stacking up — new signups, upgrades, payments. Vertical.

name: We're hiring
description: Open roles as chips with a careers link — square for LinkedIn.

name: Product ad
description: A square ad: announcement, your product screenshot and a button.

name: Product explainer
description: Three scenes — the problem, your product, the call to action — with slides between.

name: Feature reel
description: Your app on a phone while three feature headlines slide by — vertical.

name: Free trial end card
description: Your logo, a closing line and a big trial button.

name: Brand intro
description: Your logo pops in over a flowing gradient, then your title.

name: Chapter card
description: A chapter label and title on a dark gradient — drop between sections.

name: Interview lower third
description: A name and role that slide in over the speaker, then fade away.

name: Speaker card
description: A headshot and name card for webinar and podcast speakers.

name: News bulletin
description: A LIVE badge and a news bar over footage, ready for a headline.

name: Product promo
description: Your product in a browser, a bold sale headline, a price tag and a call to action.

name: End screen
description: Thanks for watching, with a subscribe button over a gradient.

name: Quote card
description: A serif quote and its author on a warm card — 1:1 for feeds.

name: Stat highlight
description: One big number with a label, popping in over a dark background.

name: Reel hook
description: A bold hook over your clip on a phone, ending on a follow button — vertical.

name: App walkthrough
description: Two app clips on a phone, one after the other, with a kicker title and hashtags — vertical.

name: 3 tips
description: A vertical list of three tips with a badge, ending on a comment prompt.

name: Review card
description: A customer quote card with a star rating and their headshot — 1:1.
